reviews.title: The perfect case for Noctua enthusiasts.
reviews.comment:
It’s expensive, but still less than the sum of its parts.
The case is fantastic. Easy to build in. The fans aren’t just included, Noctua gives tons of information on placement and fan curves. Cables are pre-routed for recommended fan layouts. The whole fan kit comes neatly assembled and easily labeled. Fan controller pre-installed. The whole presentation is top notch.
If you’re going for a themed build or are looking for a great airflow case and planning to pick up a handful of Noctua fans anyway….this is worth a look.
One word of caution….although it’s listed as supporting EATX, it does not support the larger 13x12 EATX boards. This information is buried on Noctua’s website.
reviews.author: CubicleGangster
